title: docs(adr): rewrite ADR-0146 for package-level override — customizations live in <base>.custom through a declared override (folds #28145)
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task, verbatim (2026-10-30, desktop session): 「adr 146还没开始开发，可以直接改」 with 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」 and 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (P0, child **N-01**) · governs: ADR-0146 (rewritten in place) · lane: `domain:skills` (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H — the maintainer hand-merges) · size: M.

**Business reason.** Every code card of the epic changes a gate an accepted ADR pins today (ADR-0126 D1 and D4 wall 1, ADR-0131 D6, ADR-0005's five-type tier, ADR-0048 §3.3, ADR-0009 `executionPinned`, ADR-0141 D3). Without the record rewritten first, each implementation PR is refused by its own pin tests or argues the ruling again. ADR-0146 has no implementation yet, so the maintainer ruled to rewrite it rather than add a superseding record.

**Wanted.**
1. Rewrite `docs/adr/0146-*.md` as the package-level override record: every customization of an installed package lives in `<base>.custom`; an existing item is overridden by an explicit declaration in the item **body** (`overrides: { package, basedOn }`, whole-document replace); undeclared same-name refused at publish; only items inside the dependency closure; one effective read for package-less, base-named, layered, list and export reads; flows served over the code package, rebound in one reload, ledger identity inherited, real version pinning; `.custom` auto-created without a prompt, dependency declared, namespace explicit `<base_ns>_custom` (never derived); uninstall of a base refused while its `.custom` exists; extension fields end in `__c`, reserved to `.custom` packages; base-field changes limited to a display-property whitelist; package-less overlay rows migrated then closed; clone kept only as "new similar"; Packaged automation retired after the ledger switch and landing counts; permission sets, positions and capabilities not overridable.
2. Keep ADR-0146's Studio/Setup boundary (D1 catalog in Studio, D5 browse entry, D6 no fields table, D7 Setup pages); move the item toolbar ahead of customization.
3. A supersede table: each clause of ADR-0005/0009/0048/0126/0131/0141 it overrides → the new rule → the gate and pin test that change (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts#refusePackagedBaseOverride`, `protocol-environment-rows.ts#packagelessAddress`, `flow-precedence.ts#resolveFlowPrecedence`, `run-resume.ts#resolveResumeTarget`, `registry.ts` extension merge, `namespace-prefix.ts#deriveNamespaceFromPackageId`, `protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts`).
4. Status-line pointers on those six records (ADR-0005's line is the model).
5. Fold PR #28145's three wording fixes in and close that PR.
6. Every quote verbatim and untranslated; symbols as `path#symbol` anchors.

**Acceptance.** `adr-index.mjs --check`, `check-adr-links.mjs`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` pass; the maintainer hand-merges.

**Not here.** Any code; the epic's other cards are cut after this merges.

**Dedupe.** `"package-level override"` open+closed: 4 hits, none on this topic. PR #28145 is folded in, not duplicated.

Links back: #28236, #28130, ADR-0146 (`cdbf08d1`).
